scope: NHL pregame individual game totals, moneyline and puck line
distinction: Production here means the designated champion in scoreboards and immutable forecast records. It does not mean a verified live execution pipeline or authority to place wagers.

individual_totals.champion_family: observed market no-vig baseline + previous-season prior + frozen broad-segment residual offset shrunken with k=200
challengers: NHL V15 Conditional Count / OU V6

moneyline.champion_family: observed two-sided market no-vig anchor + frozen broad-segment residual offset shrunken with k=200

puck_line.champion_family: observed two-sided market no-vig anchor + frozen broad-segment residual offset shrunken with k=200

preserved_unmodified: NHL Grand Salami Spread Day-0 V1
all NBA production and research models
all earlier frozen NHL forecasts and past scoreboards
actual Bovada reconciled transactional P&L authority

scoring_rules.eligible_quote: timestamp-observed, full paired pregame odds on same sportsbook and line, verified side orientation
scoring_rules.missing_input: NOT_SCORED / RESEARCH_NO_BET; never manufacture prices, fitted predictions or no-vig replacement edges
scoring_rules.market_math: moneyline complements, home/away plus/minus 1.5 outcomes, integer-total push-aware EV and settlement
scoring_rules.challenger_outputs: side by side on identical pregame quote snapshots
scoring_rules.normal_display: Qualifying candidates first, then chronological No Bet / Research & Unapproved; hide Pass but retain every observation in the immutable ledger
scoring_rules.full_kelly: diagnostic only when an independently calibrated model probability exists
scoring_rules.adjusted_kelly: N/A until posterior-aware joint portfolio inference is validated

validation_note: 2023-25 Day-0 historical comparisons are retrospective and sparse in key quote regimes; they do not establish sportsbook advantage. Prospective 2026-27 freezes are required.
prior_role_override: Supersedes V15/ML V3/PL V1 champion role labels only; those models, their fitted artifacts, frozen predictions and historical metrics are unchanged.
